title: WinterSports
description: I add some cool winter sports like ice skating to neoforge using Geckolib to make my favorites winter sport activities
body:
# Wintersports

This nice NeoForge mod adds custom features all around the winter and sports, but you've probably already guessed that from the mod title

## Content(1.0Beta):

### IceSkates!

<details>
<summary>nothing Interesting but read it if you want</summary>

I like ice skating.
And I don't know why I haven't found any mod about ice skating, but this doesn't mean much because I'm genuenly not so good at finding things. So I made it myself;D
and I actually think that it turned out nice, so go check it out for you

</details>

![Me with the ice skates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6eeb6c24d6644611b5bf879dd0372aca257c1d2d_0.webp)

the **ice skates** do have
- a custom model
- a custom texture
- a custom game mechanic(makes you faster on ice and slower on land)
- can be found in the creative menu
- can be crafted using 2iceskateblades, 1leatherboots(or 4 leather), 1 string

### Ice SkateBlades
an Item witch can be used to craft the ice skates

one iron ingot can be transformed into 4blades using a cutter

### The project also has:
- a custom CreativeTab

# Last words:

This mod is under development... like [many other cool mods of mine](https://modrinth.com/user/AGenius)

For bug/gramatiq finding and ideas to add please contact me on the [The Genious Discord Server](https://discord.gg/N5rvzpJ6S)

Please check out [my other stuff](https://modrinth.com/user/AGenius) too, _Thanks for reading this_
